projects.title: Chat Microservice - Real-Time Messaging Platform
projects.description: Engineered a horizontally-scalable chat system supporting 100k+ concurrent users.
keyFeatures: Real-time presence tracking and notifications via Redis Pub/Sub
Distributed load balancing across multiple instances
GraphQL subscription APIs for real-time data synchronization
projects.impact: Enabled seamless real-time communication at scale

caseStudy.problemStatement: Need to support 100k+ concurrent users with low latency and presence management
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: WebSocket with Redis Pub/Sub for presence; GraphQL subscriptions for real-time data; horizontal scaling with Docker
caseStudy.results: Sub-100ms latency, 95% test coverage, scalable across instances

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Slot Booking Platform
projects.description: SaaS platform with strict multi-tenancy and data isolation.
keyFeatures: Row-level security and per-client data segregation
Optimistic concurrency control to prevent double-bookings
Dynamic slot allocation with real-time calendar synchronization
Razorpay payment integration with automated payouts
projects.impact: Enterprise-grade reliability for B2B SaaS across tenants

caseStudy.problemStatement: Need strict data isolation and real-time calendar sync across tenants
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: Tenant-aware data model, row-level security, optimistic locking
decisions: Per-tenant schemas vs shared collections with tenant_id
caseStudy.results: Reliable multi-tenant operations with zero overbooking incidents

projects.title: Transportation & Freight Booking Platform (Navodaya Transport)
projects.description: Role-based freight booking with real-time tracking and payments.
keyFeatures: SIM-based GPS tracking via Traqo integration
End-to-end payment workflows from booking to settlement
Admin dashboard for user mgmt and payment reconciliation
projects.impact: Streamlined freight operations with transparent tracking and payments

caseStudy.problemStatement: Need secure role-based access and end-to-end payment flow with live tracking
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: RBAC, GPS integration, payment reconciliation pipeline
decisions: Use Traqo GPS for live tracking
caseStudy.results: End-to-end lifecycle with traceable payments and status updates
